## Highlights

This patch release corrects reversed heating/cooling changeover sensor readings.

### Heating/cooling changeover sensor reports the actual mode (#344)

`HeatingCoolingSensor.state` now reports `"heating"` for `AL_HEATING_COOLING` value `"1"` and `"cooling"` for `"0"`, matching how room temperature controllers behave on real systems. Previously these modes were reversed. Other values still report `"unknown"`.
